q: Beat constable favours one religion in festival `bandobast`, promise hurt?
options: Equal respect to all faiths hurt
expl: Secular promise needs equal respect no state religion.
why: Bias breaches neutrality. Duty is even-handed protection.

q: Migrant proof reviewed: birth parents stay papers, officer asks bribe for citizen tag, correct?
options: Citizenship by start rules plus 1955 Act; SI only verifies forwards
expl: Start rules plus Parliament Act decide; police verify.
why: Single card not conclusive. Competent authority decides.

q: Municipality demolishes shop no notice no law, vendor cries rights, correct?
options: Local body is state; needs fair law
expl: Local authorities covered as state.
why: Municipal act is state action. Needs legal power.

q: Old 1948 tax rule continues and curbs freedom, can court test it?
options: Pre-start laws void to extent of clash
expl: Pre-start inconsistent laws void to extent.
why: Continuance conditional. Clash part falls.

q: Pamphlet urges unity peacefully, SI seizes without law, correct?
expl: Liberty-expression protected barring defined limit.
why: Safety feeling insufficient. Law with reason needed.

q: Poster says integrity added 1976 means states can secede, correct?
expl: Integrity added 1976 reinforces one nation.
why: Addition strengthens bond. Secession reading inverts.

q: Person takes foreign passport voluntarily then claims dual vote, correct?
options: Voluntary foreign tag ends Indian claim
expl: Voluntary foreign acquisition ends status.
why: Single allegiance rule. Claim needs fresh process.

q: aided varsity expels without hearing, claims private so no rights test, correct?
options: May be other authority if state control test met
expl: Control-funding-function test can make it state.
why: Form not decisive. State-like power invites review.

q: Custom bars Dalit entry to well, defended as old custom, test?
options: Custom with force of law tested; clash void
expl: Custom law tested against rights.
why: Age no shield. Exclusion fails.

q: New Act curbs freedom vs amendment changing same freedom, difference?
options: Act void if clash; amendment valid unless basic structure hit
expl: Acts tested; amendments exempt but basic structure guards.
why: 24th drew line. Kesavananda fenced power.

q: Socialist vs secular added 1976?
options: Socialist welfare gap cut; secular equal respect
expl: One economic welfare other faith neutrality.
why: Distinct aims. Merge confuses.

q: Domicile start claim vs later Act path?
options: Start rules fixed 1950 lot; later births etc by 1955 Act
expl: Start lot by charter; later by Parliament law.
why: Time splits source. Wrong window misapplies.

q: Local body vs other authority?
options: Local named; other needs control test
expl: Local expressly state; other via power test.
why: Text plus cases. Conflation skips test.

q: Pre-start voidness vs post-start voidness?
options: Pre void to extent; post void for clash if contravenes
expl: Pre-start extent formula; post contravention void.
why: Wording differs. Extent matters for severance.

q: Preamble part vs amendable?
options: Part and amendable but basic soul guarded
expl: Kesavananda part plus amendable within structure.
why: Berubari overruled on part. Power fenced.

q: S1 Three words added 1976. S2 Preamble part of charter. S3 Parliament can destroy soul?
expl: Added 1976 part true; destroy false.
why: Amendable yes. Basic structure fences.

q: S1 Start domicile rules. S2 Pakistan move cut-offs. S3 SI alone grants status?
expl: Start plus movement true; grant by authority not SI.
why: Police verify forward. S3 overstates power.

q: S1 Govt Parliament state legislatures state. S2 Local bodies state. S3 Pure private shop always state?
expl: First two true; pure private not state.
why: Control-function test needed. S3 overbroad.

q: S1 Old laws tested. S2 Custom tested. S3 Amendment is ordinary law for bar?
expl: Old custom tested; amendment exempt by 24th.
why: Exemption overruled Golaknath bar. S3 revives it.

q: S1 Golaknath barred change. S2 24th exempted amendment. S3 Kesavananda fenced with basic guard?
expl: All three true sequence.
why: Bar response fence is correct chain. Each step factual.
